parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for human mTOR kinase with publication provenance. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by target name 'mTOR' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50'. Require exact measurements (standard_relation = '='). Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure availability. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
